name: external-sso-readiness
brief: Prepare DM Auth to serve an external application (a .NET API + React SPA) signing in through its authorization-code + PKCE flow. First restore a solution that builds (IW-001: remove the NU1605 package downgrade and pin Infrastructure's floating versions) and test projects that actually run tests (NT-001: VSTest runner packages in both projects, plus a declared Key Vault switch so integration tests need no Azure credentials). Then fix the flow: the token endpoint verifies a confidential client's client_secret from the form on both the code exchange and refresh rotation, returning invalid_client before any code or token lookup (DA-001); the code redirect keeps a redirect URI's existing query (IW-004); GrantConsent rejects an unregistered redirect URI or a disallowed scope before issuing a code (DA-002); the consent form posts to the API base URL (FE-003); and the login page classifies returnUrl so the authorize resume URL is loaded with a full navigation and anything foreign falls back to the dashboard (FE-004). Five tasks, a serialized dotnet chain T1-T4 and a frontend task T5.
